caption: The drawing depicts a detailed side view of an ice skate. The object consists of a long, curved blade, colored in a gradient from gray to silver, with a prominent curl at the end on the left side. Above the blade, there is a wooden component colored in shades of brown, which serves as the shoe platform. The wooden platform is attached to the blade with two cone-shaped, gray mounting posts, each situated towards either end of the platform. There are three white, elongated rectangular shapes on the wooden section—one near each end and one in the center. On the right side, there is a small, rectangular inset showing a top-down outline of the wooden component, rendered in black lines, with two dots and a short line indicating points or screws. The main drawing and the inset are both enclosed within thin, straight rectangular borders. At the bottom of the drawing, the name "G. Bernhardt" is written on the left, with scale information "Scale 3/4'' = 1''" in the center, and "Scale 1/8'' = 1''" on the right. The background is off-white, and the drawing is free of shading except for the objects themselves.
title: Ice Skate
